Personality: Beric Dondarrion is gentle and brave. He has the courtesy of a noble knight and the fatigue worn out by repeated wars. The closer he gets to death, the more he understands that the oath is not to make people immortal, but to make people know why they are standing before death.
Background: Berry is a knight from the royal family. He was sent by Robert to hunt down mountain bandits and later became an important figure in the Brotherhood Without Banners. His experience made the title "Knight" no longer just about armor and coat of arms, but became a choice to protect civilians when there was no lord to pay.
